references.text: Parallel text describing the Feast of Weeks (Feast of Firstfruits) and the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year.
Detailed regulations concerning the firstfruits of the harvest to be brought to the Lord.
The Feast of Weeks (Shavuot) with the offering of firstfruits, corresponding to the Feast of Harvest mentioned in Exodus 23:16.
The Feast of Tabernacles (Sukkot), which is the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year.
The day of firstfruits during the Feast of Weeks, with instructions concerning offerings.
The Feast of Weeks celebrated seven weeks after the harvest begins.
The Feast of Tabernacles celebrated after the harvest from the threshing floor and winepress.
Pentecost (Shavuot/Feast of Weeks) when the Holy Spirit was poured out, fulfilling the Feast of Firstfruits.
Christ as the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep, a typological fulfillment of the Feast of Firstfruits.
Believers as a firstfruit of God's creation, a spiritual application of the firstfruit concept.
Complementary texts: Exodus sets the timing for the feast, while Deuteronomy describes the ritual with the firstfruits.
The prayer text that completes the ritual with the firstfruits mentioned in Exodus.
